messages.subject: Project Drake — conditions and timetable
messages.plaintextBody:
Mark, Richard,

Now signed. Position on conditions: we've made the informal CMA approach and given the modest overlap we expect a clear run, but we should allow the standard waiting period. Clydesford have indicated consent is straightforward; Stratton's consent is in train. On current estimates we're targeting completion in the week of 17 February.

Sarah

--
